messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-48219 fired -> GPU OOM on node gpu-wn-12 (eu-west-1), pool=hosted-infer-prod-a. Error=CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY. auto-retries=3, affected model=gpt-medium-8bit-q4. dash: https://dash.redwood.local/alerts/INC-48219

pagerduty: PagerDuty notification: page assigned to @sam

sam: acked, taking it. I'll start mitigation steps, ETA ~15m.

alex: i'm the night shift oncall, standing by. runbook: drain node -> restart worker -> reroute small traffic.

sam: running drain now: ```rdctl pool evict-node --pool hosted-infer-prod-a --node gpu-wn-12 --reason "OOM spike"```

sam: drain output: ```evicting 4 containers from gpu-wn-12
waiting for in-flight requests -> 12s
node cordoned: true```

maria: seeing kv-cache for some customers balloon to 28GB on that node just before OOM. suspect prefix cache retention. stack excerpt: ```cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
Model: gpt-medium-8bit-q4 | batch_size=48 | seq_len=2048```

sam: temporarily routing 15% traffic to fallback model gpt-medium-8bit-q2 to reduce memory pressure. updating routing policy now.

ryan: restarting infer worker on gpu-wn-12: `systemctl restart rw-infer-worker` -> exit 0. monitoring memory after restart.

incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation triggered (threshold: multi-tenant error rate >1.5%). Escalating to SRE lead.

priya: looping in customer-success. drafting customer notice; current impact: ~2% requests returned 502 for 12m, p95 latency up ~420ms for a subset of tenants. no data leak.

sam: node drained cleanly, evicted containers freed ~32GB. memory usage for gpt-medium-8bit-q4 back to expected baseline. p95 latency trending down.

alex: verifying smoke tests on node before uncordon: `rdctl node smoke gpu-wn-12` -> all checks pass, keeping cordon for 1h for safety.

sam: mitigation complete — traffic rebalanced, fallback removed. will monitor for 30m. creating follow-up tasks: 1) tighten kv-cache eviction for gpt-medium family, 2) add an automated guardrail to reject batch_size>40 for q4 variant, 3) postmortem owned by sam+alex. :memo:

priya: customer messaging queued, notify once final recovery confirmed. marking incident as "mitigated" in PagerDuty (will follow up with postmortem).

sam: thanks everyone. leaving notes in runbook and creating postmortem ticket. closing thread unless something else pops up. :white_check_mark:
